decisions.reason: The classic lever handle line sits in the core range and carries catalogue and tooling investment, so even without visible promotion since 2019 the firm would keep it as part of its system breadth.
This multi-model handle family represents sunk tooling and specification effort with architects, and weak visibility can still be read as normal maturation, so management persists.
This single design is less entrenched and similar to the already withdrawn Product D, but it fits the established offer and costs little to keep listed, so it is kept for now.
This lever family carries investment across several models and supports the firm's integrated system families, so persistence is likely.
The L700 electronic access system is the publicly announced flagship of the firm's digital building direction with heavy investment, so management will continue to back it.
